description: Fix Global Status multi-server support with clickable containers
changes: Updated Global Status to use ensureServerConnection instead of configure
Fixed handleOpenLogs to pass serverConfig to log-server
Now displays ALL containers (running and stopped) from all servers
features: Global Status now shows containers from all configured servers
Click on any container to view its logs in real-time
fixes: Global Status changing global server state and interfering with buttons
Clicking containers not opening logs on correct server
Only showing running containers instead of all containers
notes: Global Status now fully supports multi-server with clickable containers for logs
